title: Dr Mei (receiving clinician)
description: Persona: an emergency physician who treats visitors from other countries and reads their records through verifiable health links. Fictional.

persona.name: Dr Mei
persona.goal: Read a visitor's record quickly and know it is genuine and that she is allowed to read it.
needs: A clear answer: allowed, refused, or unknown
A record she can trust, signed by a known issuer
frustrations: Links that fail without saying why
